2607.22153.title: Industrial Tokenization for LLM-Based Health Intelligence: A Federated Architecture for Industrial Evidence Integration
2607.22153.paper_summary: Industrial health management increasingly relies on heterogeneous information sources, including condition monitoring systems, supervisory control and data acquisition systems, maintenance records, inspection results, and prognostic models. Although large language models provide new opportunities for cross-source reasoning, industrial data and analytical outputs differ substantially in structure, temporal resolution, physical meaning, and reliability. Directly integrating such heterogeneous information into a monolithic model may reduce interpretability, traceability, and adaptability to equipment and data changes. This paper introduces Industrial Tokenization, a conceptual interface for transforming source-specific analytical outputs into structured and machine-interpretable units of industrial evidence, termed Industrial Tokens. Unlike numerical tokens used to encode raw time-series data, Industrial Tokens represent domain-grounded evidence together with source, temporal scope, operating context, analytical meaning, quality or confidence information, and provenance. Based on this concept, a federated industrial architecture is proposed, where heterogeneous analytical subsystems retain autonomy while exposing standardized Industrial Tokens to a central reasoning layer. As an initial implementation, this study presents an end-to-end DiagnosisToken pathway based on vibration-diagnostic outputs, rule-based event aggregation, structured textual token generation, and LLM-based interpretation. Other Industrial Tokens, including SCADA-based condition-monitoring tokens, maintenance tokens, and prognostic tokens, are reserved as future extensions. The proposed framework positions Industrial Tokenization as a semantic interface between domain-specific industrial intelligence and LLM- or agent-based reasoning, rather than another method for encoding raw industrial data.
2607.22153.paper_summary_zh: 工業健康管理越來越依賴異質信息來源，包括狀態監測系統、監控控制和數據採集系統、維護記錄、檢查結果和預測模型。儘管大型語言模型為跨來源推理提供了新的機會，但工業數據和分析輸出在結構、時間解析度、物理意義和可靠性上有著顯著差異。直接將這些異質信息整合到一個單一模型中可能會降低可解釋性、可追溯性以及對設備和數據變化的適應能力。本文介紹了工業標記化，這是一種概念性接口，用於將源特定的分析輸出轉換為結構化和機器可解釋的工業證據單位，稱為工業標記。與用於編碼原始時間序列數據的數值標記不同，工業標記代表了基於領域的證據，並包括來源、時間範圍、操作上下文、分析意義、質量或置信信息以及來源。基於這一概念，提出了一種聯邦工業架構，其中異質分析子系統保持自主性，同時向中央推理層暴露標準化的工業標記。作為初步實現，本研究提出了一個基於振動診斷輸出的端到端診斷標記通路，該通路基於規則的事件聚合、結構化文本標記生成和基於大型語言模型的解釋。其他工業標記，包括基於SCADA的狀態監測標記、維護標記和預測標記，則保留作為未來的擴展。所提出的框架將工業標記化定位為領域特定工業智能與基於大型語言模型或代理的推理之間的語義接口，而不是另一種編碼原始工業數據的方法。
